improvement: Plugin Center icons use the sizes, positions, light and dark artwork, and circular backgrounds adjusted in Icon Studio, retaining reproducible sources and parameters
Raise compileSdk and targetSdk to 37 (Android 17); the plugin's behavior does not depend on the new target
fix: SDK XML v4 parsing warnings with AGP 9.1 and APK native alignment checks incorrectly triggered by JVM unit-test assembly tasks, using shared build plugins 1.8.3

improvement: Validate release APK versions, signing and the complete variant set before creating download artifacts
fix: Plugin center version and ABI information matches the installed plugin APK
Version dates use a consistent English format

improvement: Build verification of 16 KB page alignment for 64-bit native libraries, including manifest contract checks and JSON reports

feature: Added the selectable `launchPrivileged` / `WindowMode.Privileged` backend, with explicit `auto`, `shizuku`, and `root` launcher policies and live `Session.getBackendInfo()` diagnostics

Added a reflection-only host adapter that reuses AutoJs6 RootMode, `RootUtils` / `ProcessShell`, and the already-authorized `WrappedShizuku` UserService instead of introducing a second privilege manager
Added authenticated Binder Surface protocol v2: a privileged UID 0/2000 child owns the SurfaceControl layer and transfers only its Surface to the existing complete host renderer
Connected the privileged Type A/Type B `/dev/input` reader to the normal bounded ImGui input queue with an explicit non-grabbing observation policy and `Passthrough` callback control
fix: Selected the authoritative Android 29+ `IContentProvider.call` overload so API 31+ external-provider rendezvous preserves the real Broker authority
Changed the raw `app_process` child to a quit-enabled Looper, eliminating the false `Main thread not allowed to quit` error during otherwise successful cleanup
Restricted normal Broker binding with the AutoJs6 plugin permission, made endpoint registration one-shot, and retained UID, owner, constant-time token, and Binder-death checks
improvement: Upgraded backend capabilities and TypeScript to schema v2, including the host Root/Shizuku state, Binder transport, 256-bit token boundary, renderer location, and direct-input routing policy

Verified the real AutoJs6 host chain on API 28 Magisk root and API 31 Shizuku 13.5: UID 0/2000 Surface creation, existing JS facade rendering, Type A/Type B input discovery, screenshots, and orphan-free close all passed

feature: Added `moreTouch` window/floating-button options plus session/global `setMoreTouch`, consistently controlling `FLAG_SPLIT_TOUCH` so a button can receive a new finger while another remains down
Added `BackendStatus` and `getBackendCapabilities` with typed status for the production window backend, split touch, privileged process, direct input, Docking, and Multi-Viewport

Built an experimental independent `app_process` renderer vertical slice from SurfaceControl layer through Surface, EGL ES 3, and Dear ImGui, with a 256-bit-token authenticated local-socket frame protocol
Implemented 16/24-byte `/dev/input` event decoding, Type A/Type B multitouch tracking, rotation-aware coordinate mapping, and bounded frame-start input handoff
fix: Activity and overlay split-touch flags can now be changed at runtime; closing restores the host's original flags and existing independent buttons update with the session

The privileged protocol rejects bad magic/version, oversized or truncated payloads, and unauthenticated clients, then cleans up input, EGL, SurfaceControl, and the process after timeout, disconnect, or shutdown
improvement: Verified UID 2000-to-UID 0 socket frames, the independent ImGui layer, and `/dev/input/event6` down/move/up on a rooted API 28 device, while all three connected tests passed on API 28 and API 35 devices

Added privileged-backend and Docking/Multi-Viewport architecture records, protocol/evdev unit tests, and build-time safety inventory; P6 remains explicitly experimental and cannot yet be selected by ordinary scripts

feature: Published a complete `types/imgui.d.ts` for all 214 callable APIs, 36 constant groups, sessions, components, DrawList, and global/plugin/module entry points, guarded by a strict TypeScript smoke contract
Expanded the bundled library to five directly runnable examples: widget overview, parameter panel, log HUD, data-table demo, and theme gallery
Added an Android instrumented real-Surface render test covering init, frame construction, controls, rendering, a PixelCopy semantic screenshot baseline, and shutdown
Added GitHub Actions PR verification and signed `v*` release automation with signature checks and APK artifact publishing
Added a checksummed Dear ImGui upstream snapshot plus a safe immutable-tag/commit updater with archive verification, dry-run, and whitelisted extraction
fix: Touch, IME, key, and wheel events now enter a bounded lock-free FIFO queue consumed at frame start; lifecycle queue replacement prevents delayed events from reaching a new native session
Frame scheduling now compensates against absolute deadlines, reducing cumulative work-plus-timeout drift and resetting cleanly after late or collapsed frames
improvement: Published and enforced `Limits` for 64 KiB text input, 512 selection items, and 2,048 queued input events, with the configuration decision and safety rationale documented
Extended build verification to cross-check runtime APIs, aliases, constants, TypeScript declarations, examples, input-queue invariants, and every vendored upstream hash

feature: Added lightweight `imgui.ref(value)` and `{ value: ... }` references across every stateful widget while retaining the legacy Java-array helpers
Added session-managed `logWindow` and stacked, timed `toast` notifications with level colors, export, and deterministic cleanup
Added Promise-based `alert`, `confirm`, `singleChoice`, and `multiChoice` dialogs with queued modal presentation
Added a threshold-colored `statsOverlay` and selectable `dataTable` with stable rows, CRUD operations, toolbar actions, and custom rendering
Bundled the complete `widget-overview` example with `listExamples`, `getExampleSource`, `runExample`, and host-discovery metadata
fix: Pending modal promises now resolve to deterministic cancellation values and all high-level components are disposed when their session closes
Example source lookup is restricted to a contract whitelist and rejects path traversal
Serialized the late-Surface recovery probe with Android holder callbacks, preventing duplicate native initialization on slower devices
improvement: Added `LogLevel` and `ToastPosition`, bringing the constant inventory to 35 groups, plus PascalCase aliases and expanded source verification
Validated high-level rendering, public example execution, result semantics, and cleanup on a physical OpenGL ES 3.2 device

feature: Added `TouchMode.Touchable` / `Passthrough` / `Auto`; Auto mode uses per-ImGui-window transparent touch proxies so blank overlay areas reach apps underneath
Added session `collapse` / `expand`, a low-FPS mini bubble, independently draggable `addButtonEx`, and runtime alpha and `FLAG_SECURE` controls
Added `imgui.launch` full-screen Activity mode and explicit `launchFloaty` overlay mode; one renderer supports multiple `begin` / `withWindow` roots
Added responsive display tracking, `AlwaysAutoResize` outer-window sizing, optional `iniPath` persistence, and session event callbacks
fix: Surface destruction now detaches and later reattaches without discarding the EGL/ImGui context or managed texture handles
Automatic pass-through uses public Android window/view APIs and limits touch proxies to 64 interactive roots
improvement: Expanded the JNI surface from 186 to 190 bindings and extended source verification across the P3 session facade
Activity flags, system UI state, overlay windows, touch proxies, and floating buttons are restored or cleaned up deterministically on close
Declared the OpenGL ES 3.0 hardware requirement in the APK manifest and installation documentation

feature: Added session-managed `createTexture` for file paths, encoded `byte[]` / `ByteBuffer` data, Android `Bitmap`, streams, and AutoJs6 `Image` objects
Added `image` / `imageButton` with natural-size and aspect-ratio helpers, UV ranges, tint colors, and backgrounds
Connected AutoJs6 `images.read` and screenshot results directly to texture creation without recycling caller-owned images
Added window, foreground, and background DrawList layers with line, rectangle, circle, triangle, text, polyline, cubic Bézier, and image primitives
fix: Bitmap uploads now honor row stride and undo Android premultiplied alpha, preserving translucent colors without dark fringes
Texture disposal is deferred until queued draw data has rendered; stale, disposed, and cross-session handles are rejected safely
improvement: Expanded the JNI surface from 172 to 186 bindings and extended source verification across the texture and DrawList facade
Added 128 MiB encoded-data, 32-megapixel, and OpenGL maximum-size guards, with automatic cleanup of all remaining session textures

feature: Added 11 complete themes through `Themes` / `setTheme(name)`, including Pink, Blue, ModernDark, CyanDusk, OrangeDark, CrystalClear, VibrantNight, and PurpleDream
Added persistent `setStyleColor` and bulk `setStyleProperties`; `createWindow` now accepts `theme`, `appearance`, `style`, and direct rounding, border, and shadow shortcuts
Activated the `AssetManager` font channel with a bundled CJK fallback subset of about 9,800 characters, preserving common Chinese text on stripped systems without Noto CJK
Added `Fonts`, `pushFont` / `popFont` / `withFont`, and `createWindow.fonts` for asset/file fonts, named handles, and Dear ImGui 1.92 dynamic sizes
Bundled a 38-glyph Material Icons subset with the `Icons` table and `icon(name, label)` helper
fix: Theme changes now reset deterministically from the density-scaled baseline while preserving the current font size and global font scales
improvement: Expanded the JNI surface from 167 to 172 bindings; source verification now checks the theme/font facade inventory and SHA-256 integrity of both font assets
The default and additional fonts merge the CJK fallback and icon glyphs, so scripts do not have to assemble fallback atlases manually

feature: System IME integration: focusing `inputText` / `inputTextMultiline` automatically opens the soft keyboard with composing text, committed text, and editing keys such as Backspace, Enter, and the arrows
Added `setKeyboardFocusHere` so scripts can actively focus the next input widget and hand it to the IME
Two-finger scrolling now has configurable inertial decay through the `fling` / `flingFriction` / `flingMinVelocity` / `flingMaxVelocity` window options
A configurable one-finger long press emits a right click; added the `beginPopupContextItem` / `beginPopupContextWindow` / `withContextItem` / `withContextWindow` context-popup family
fix: Cancelling a window drag, two-finger scroll, or long-press transition now clears the active widget, preventing accidental left clicks and cancelled right-click popups
Registered the SurfaceHolder callback before creating the IME proxy so an already-valid surface cannot leave the rendering session uninitialized
The soft-keyboard request now retries after the overlay gains window focus instead of being lost when Android has not served the IME view yet
Corrected startup documentation to use `plugins.load` by default and describe host auto-mount as an optional AutoJs6 setting
improvement: Extended `verifyImGuiSource` into a three-layer JNI → Java connection → JavaScript facade wrapper-coverage check
IME composition is synchronized by replacing the previous pre-edit string, so scripts do not have to manage the candidate process

feature: Table API family: `withTable` / `beginTable` / `tableNextRow` / `tableNextColumn` / `tableSetupColumn` / `tableSetupScrollFreeze` / `tableHeadersRow` / `tableSetBgColor` with borders, row stripes, frozen rows/columns, and background colors
Popups and menus: `openPopup` / `withPopup` / `withPopupModal` / `closeCurrentPopup` / `isPopupOpen` / `withMenuBar` / `withMenu` / `menuItem`
Tooltips: `setTooltip` / `setItemTooltip` / `withTooltip` / `withItemTooltip`
Mobile-style `toggle` switch widget with `toggleSwitch` and `ToggleSwitch` aliases

More widgets and text items: `separatorText` / `bullet` / `bulletText` / `labelText` / `textDisabled` / `arrowButton` / `invisibleButton` / `inputInt` / `inputFloat` / `inputTextMultiline` / `listBox` / `withListBox` / `colorPicker3` / `colorPicker4` / `colorButton` / `plotLines` / `plotHistogram` / `treeNodeEx` / `vSliderFloat` / `vSliderInt` / `withCombo`

Style stacks and structure APIs: `pushStyleColor` / `popStyleColor` / `pushStyleVar` / `popStyleVar` / `setWindowFontScale` / `pushId` / `withId` / `withGroup` / `withDisabled` / `indent` / `unindent` / `alignTextToFramePadding`
Scrolling family: `getScrollX/Y` / `getScrollMaxX/Y` / `setScrollX/Y` / `setScrollHereX/Y`

State queries: `isItemActive` / `isItemEdited` / `isItemDeactivatedAfterEdit` / `isItemFocused` / `isWindowHovered` / `isWindowFocused` / `isWindowCollapsed` / `isMouseDown` / `isMouseClicked` / `isMouseDragging` / `getMousePos` / `getMouseDragDelta` / `calcTextSize` / `getFrameHeight` / `framerate`, and more
Input primitives: `addInputCharacters` / `addKeyEvent` / `sendKey` / `addMouseWheel` / `wantTextInput`, laying the event channel for upcoming IME support
Two-finger vertical swipe scrolls window content, automatically distinguished from single-finger window dragging

Constant tables expanded to 24 groups with the new `ChildFlags` / `ComboFlags` / `PopupFlags` / `HoveredFlags` / `FocusedFlags` / `ColorEditFlags` / `TableFlags` / `TableColumnFlags` / `TableRowFlags` / `TableBgTarget` / `Col` / `StyleVar` / `Dir` / `Key` / `ButtonFlags`
fix: Fixed a race between the touch thread and the render thread on the native context; interaction queries now read an end-of-frame snapshot
Added the missing PascalCase aliases for `WantCaptureMouse` and `StyleColorsDark` / `StyleColorsLight` / `StyleColorsClassic`
improvement: Documentation and samples now describe the host-resident global object mechanism and no longer suggest calling `plugins.load`
The required host version code and the ABI list are now single-sourced from `ImGuiPluginContract` and parsed by the build script
Every new API ships with a PascalCase alias matching its Dear ImGui counterpart

feature: Global `imgui` object automatically mounted into script engines by the host
Transparent floating windows rendered by Dear ImGui 1.92.9 with configurable dimensions, frame rate, fonts, and blank-area dragging
Immediate-mode window, layout, text, input, selection, color, progress, tree, tab, theme, and demo APIs
Mutable Boolean, integer, floating-point, string, and color references for stateful controls
Localized plugin metadata, usage instructions, README, and changelog for ten languages
dependency: Added the bundled Common Plugin API for plugin discovery metadata
Added Kotlin standard library and Parcelize runtime version 2.2.21
Added Apache Commons Compress 1.28.0 and XZ for Java 1.10 for build tooling
Added JUnit version 4.13.2 for plugin contract tests
